title: PONTOS NEGATIVOS DA NOVA BIKE SPEED SUNPEED MARS A

takeaways.text: The perforated saddle's centre section flexes, which he fears will drift from a bike-fit setting over time.
The micro-adjust seatpost is thinner than he would like for heavier riders.
The frame's smoothed welds look like carbon from a distance, but welds remain visible around the fork and underside.
He notes it is said to weigh over 9 kg, still to be weighed in a later video.

disclosure: The presenter bought the bike and asks viewers for donations; the video calls it the Mars A without stating whether it is the A PRO trim, and the bike had not yet been ridden. Portuguese automatic captions.
summary: A Brazilian buyer's first-impression list of negatives on a new SUNPEED Mars A alloy road bike before riding it.
